questions.stem: Two lines are parallel. If one has gradient $3$, what is the gradient of the other?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have equal gradients. If one line has gradient $3$, any line parallel to it also has gradient $3$.

questions.stem: A line has gradient $4$. What is the gradient of a line perpendicular to it?
questions.explanation: Perpendicular lines have gradients that are negative reciprocals: $m_1 \times m_2 = -1$. So $m_2 = -\frac{1}{4}$.

questions.stem: Which of these lines is parallel to $y = 2x + 5$?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines share the same gradient. The line $y = 2x + 5$ has gradient $2$, and $y = 2x - 1$ also has gradient $2$.
